title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "GitHub Copilot"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, name = "gps_fixes") |>
  arrange(month)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_speed = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_speed = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_speed = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_speed = sd(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  group_by(season, month) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(season, month)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(ggridges)

mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = after_stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 2, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  labs(
    x = "Speed",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Speed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
